items.title: BlockStrap: Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A maximum-severity vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code on Magento and Adobe Commerce store servers through a second-pass template engine directive injection.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including CVE-2026-103849, which could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via PHP code injection in Magento's template system, with active exploitation observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution, and Adobe is aware of it being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization / Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges, with indications of active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, which could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.
